Snoring & Sleep Apnea Treatment

Expert Sleep Apnea Treatment,
& TMJ Specialists in San Diego

We are your one-stop shop for all things sleep and dental. That’s right – a good night’s sleep starts with the dentist. Schedule a 15 minute consultation for any of our services at no cost.
Call 619-657-0787

Who We Are?

Looking and feeling your best starts with a good night’s sleep. San Diego Sleep Center provides exceptional sleep treatments and dental care for patients of all ages and walks of life. We specialize in the treatment of snoring, sleep apnea, and TMJ disorder. Our team will work with you to create personalized treatments that suit your lifestyle – and lead to a better night’s sleep.

We also provide a full range of on-site dental treatments including orthopedics, veneers, and full-mouth restorations. That way your smile looks as good as you feel!

Learn More

Why Choose Our San Diego Sleep & TMJ Clinic

Patient-centered
Addressing the unique needs of our individual patients is our first priority. We treat everyone with the same care and respect as family.

Our downtown San Diego office is easy to get to and features the latest high-tech equipment and modern amenities.

Our professional, courteous staff are at the top of their fields. We promise to make your visit productive, stress-free, and enjoyable.

Our Services

Snoring
Don’t let snoring disrupt you or your loved ones’ sleep. Simple treatments can help you wake feeling better and more rested.

Sleep Apnea

TMJ

Our TMJ and Sleep Specialists

Meet our team of knowledgeable, experienced doctors. With nearly 50 years of combined experience, our doctors are ready to help you look and feel your best.

Dr. Mojaver

Dr. Nina Mojaver earned her DMD from Tufts University and holds multiple advanced certifications in the fields of cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, craniofacial pain, and dental sleep medicine. Dr. Mojaver has also completed postdoctoral studies at Harvard School of Medicine and is currently an active alumnus at both Tufts and Harvard. She has more than 25 years of experience refining her keen eye for aesthetics and engineering stunning smiles.

Dr. Pavlisin

Dr. Pavlisin earned her DDS from the University of Illinois and has served as a clinical professor at Western University Dental College in Pomona, CA, for the last 13 years. Her advanced training and experience concentrate on smile cosmetics, TMJ and jaw joint pain and dysfunction, and oral facial pain issues. She includes Invisalign and laser dentistry. Throughout Dr. Pavlisin’s nearly 40 years in practice, she has pursued advanced training with the Pankey Institute, Dawson Center for Advanced Education, Piper Center for Advanced Dentistry, Spear Education, and UCLA mini-residency.
